class Animal { name = 'animal'; }
class Dog extends Animal { bark() { return 'woof'; } }

class DogMethods {
  handle(dog: Dog) { return dog.bark(); }
}

interface DogInterface { handle(dog: Dog): string }
const dogInterface: DogInterface = new DogMethods();

class DogHandler {
  constructor(dog: Dog) { console.log(dog.bark()); }
}

const fromClass: (animal: Animal) => string = new DogMethods().handle;
const fromInterface: (animal: Animal) => string = dogInterface.handle;
const explicit: new (animal: Animal) => DogHandler = DogHandler;
